summary:
bash: set -eu
T=$(mktemp -d /tmp/aclreplica.XXXX); chmod 755 "$T"
mkdir "$T/shared"
getfacl -p /srv/shared > "$T/acl.txt"
setfacl --set-file="$T/acl.txt" "$T/shared"   # copy ACLs onto the replica
chmod 2770 "$T/shared"; chgrp research "$T/shared"
chmod o+rx "$T"                                # let alice/bob traverse to it
STAT=$(stat -c '%a %U:%G' "$T/shared")
echo "replica: $STAT"
echo "--- alice creates a file ---"
su alice -c "umask 022; echo alice-data > '$T/shared/a.txt'" ; echo "alice write exit=$?"
echo "--- bob creates a file ---"
su bob   -c "umask 022; echo bob-data   > '$T/shared/b.txt'" ; echo "bob write exit=$?"
echo "--- bob reads alice's file, alice reads bob's ---"
su bob   -c "cat '$T/shared/a.txt'"; echo "bob reads a.txt exit=$?"
su alice -c "cat '$T/shared/b.txt'"; echo "alice reads b.txt exit=$?"
echo "--- bob appends to alice's file ---"
su bob -c "echo more >> '$T/shared/a.txt'"; echo "bob appends exit=$?"
echo "--- new files / dirs ---"
ls -l "$T/shared"
stat -c '%a %U:%G %n' "$T/shared"/*
echo "=== new files carry alice/bob rwx ACLs, group research ==="
getfacl -cp "$T/shared/a.txt"
echo "--- alice makes a subdir, bob writes inside it (inheritance) ---"
su alice -c "mkdir '$T/shared/sub'"
stat -c '%a %U:%G %n' "$T/shared/sub"
getfacl -cp "$T/shared/sub"
su bob -c "echo nested > '$T/shared/sub/b.txt'"; echo "bob writes in sub exit=$?"
su alice -c "cat '$T/shared/sub/b.txt'"; echo "alice reads nested exit=$?"
echo "--- outsider (nobody) is denied ---"
su nobody -s /bin/sh -c "cat '$T/shared/a.txt'" 2>&1; echo "nobody read exit=$?"
su nobody -s /bin/sh -c "echo x > '$T/shared/n.txt'" 2>&1; echo "nobody write exit=$?"
su nobody -s /bin/sh -c "ls '$T/shared'" 2>&1; echo "nobody ls exit=$?"
su nobody -s /bin/sh -c "cat '$T/shared/sub/b.txt'" 2>&1; echo "nobody nested exit=$?"
chmod o-rx "$T"
echo "REPLICA=$T"
